I talk to the United States Studies Center’s [\@2020VisionCast podcast](https://www.ussc.edu.au/analysis/2020vision-could-the-us-china-trade-deal-save-or-sink-trump) about last week’s tentative trade deal between the US and China, US Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross’s visit to Australia and other topics.
